resources.string: Noted: more of this. Applies from the next edition; the video is on your like list.
Noted: less of this. Applies from the next edition; nothing is hidden.
Only on this device: \"More of this\" slightly lifts the channel and topic in the next editions, \"Less of this\" moves them back. Nothing is hidden, nothing is sent, no lock.
No ratings yet. Long-press a video: \"More or less of this…\".
Empty. Videos you rate \"More of this\" appear here, so you can like them on YouTube later.
\"Like on YouTube\" opens the video outside ZenPipe (YouTube app or browser), where you can like it while signed in. Then tap \"Done\".
